name: IHS Grants
summary: Small grants of up to $1,500 for herpetological research, conservation and education projects by individuals or organisations; mixes research, captive husbandry and conservation work.
reporting: A summary or final report by the set dates, covering objectives or methods, conclusions, recommendations and a statement of expenses; findings presented at a future symposium.
